svg.title: ULTRA-SATISFACTORY
svg.desc: A demoscene banner: chrome spheres over a checkerboard. ULTRA SATISFACTORY floats in the sky as a thick italic chrome logo, steel blue with a bright break line across each row of letters, its sides running back to the vanishing point. Below it a grey and white checker floor of foundations flies towards the viewer and drifts sideways, fading into haze at a low horizon. Six mirror balls tinted from cyan through purple to pink bounce over it in a wave, each reflecting the moving floor and the sky, each with a soft shadow. The sky runs a one-minute day: dusty mauve afternoon, the sun setting at the right, a starry indigo night with the moon and coloured light pooling under the spheres, then dawn. Small type above the logo says REFLECTIVE ASSETS DIVISION presents; under it: every recipe, building and Space Elevator objective, one click apart. A small gold scroller at the horizon lists the three tabs (Objectives, Items, Buildings), the counts (140 items, 211 recipes of which 88 are alternates, 477 buildings, 5 Space Elevator phases), how to run it (python -m pip install -r requirements.txt, then python -m streamlit run app/app.py, or nothing to install at lukexyz.github.io/ULTRA-SATISFACTORY), and that it is an unofficial fan project.
